blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Yet Thai treebanks, speech metrics and morphological resources are built on words, often at several granularities, and word boundaries resolve ambiguities that subword tokens leave open. LATTE (Lattice ATTentive Encoding) reads a text at several granularities at once, through a lattice of dictionary words, but it is a large GPU model. We distil it into LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, a CPU segmenter of 1.17M parameters that keeps the lattice as features. It outputs compounds, words and morphemes in one pass, and learns only from annotated data and text whose licences allow commercial use. To compare it with other tools, published Thai scores do not suffice, as they come from different files, splits and scorers. We therefore rebuild seven test sets from pinned sources and score twelve systems under one protocol. With the unit that fits each test set, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite scores above DeepCut on five sets, four of them from corpora that its teachers learnt from. Called line by line on one CPU thread, it runs 23 times as fast as DeepCut. We release the model, the benchmark scripts and all predictions.

blocks.en:
Large language models read Thai through subword tokens, without a word segmenter. Word segmentation can thus look
like a task of the past, as it did for neural models of Chinese ( Li et al., 2019 ) . Yet word boundaries carry
information that subword tokens do not.
Japanese pre-trained models do better with a morphological analyser before the subword
tokeniser ( Fujii et al., 2023 ) . In Chinese, up to a quarter of word boundaries fall inside a token, and
this mismatch misleads current models ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Asking a large model to segment
is no shortcut, as a prompted GPT-4, which knows no convention, reaches 75–76 token F1 on Thai segmentation ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Words also remain the units of treebanks, of the
word error rate of speech recognisers and of morphological
resources ( de Marneffe et al., 2021 ; Phatthiyaphaibun et al., 2022 ; Sirichotedumrong et al., 2026 ) . These resources use words at
several granularities, from compounds to words and morphemes.

blocks.en:
LATTE, Lattice ATTentive Encoding ( Chay-intr et al., 2023 ) , brings several granularities to the input. It was
proposed for
languages written without spaces between words, and evaluated on Thai, Chinese and Japanese. A string in such a
language often has several readings, so LATTE reads a text at several granularities at once
(Figure 1 ). It joins the characters and every dictionary word that matches them in a lattice, and a
graph attention network encodes this lattice over a pre-trained encoder.

blocks.en:
In practice, however, Thai segmenters trade accuracy against speed
(Figure 2 ). LATTE is a GPU model, and on one CPU thread a LATTE model of this paper segments only
66 characters per second. DeepCut ( Kittinaradorn et al., 2019 ) is accurate, averaging
84 word F1 over our seven test sets, but segments only 2.6K characters per second.
AttaCut ( Chormai et al., 2019 ) is nearly as accurate, at 78–100K characters per second. The
default tokeniser of PyThaiNLP, the dictionary-based newmm ( Phatthiyaphaibun et al., 2023 ) , is
faster still, at 0.9M characters per second, but averages 71. khammoon ( Sirichotedumrong et al., 2026 ) is fast and
accurate on a CPU, but for morphemes.

Licences also matter. DeepCut, AttaCut, SEFR CUT and OSKut are released under the MIT licence. Yet DeepCut and
AttaCut were trained on BEST ( Kosawat et al., 2009 ) , whose licence is non-commercial, and SEFR CUT and OSKut
build on DeepCut. The weights of khammoon are released under a non-commercial licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0). We want a
segmenter that anyone may use commercially, as accurate as the best of them and fast on a CPU.

the long and short unit words of the Japanese corpus BCCWJ and the smallest units they are built
from ( Maekawa et al., 2014 ) . long keeps compounds whole, short gives their words and minimal their
morphemes.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Thai segmenters are of two kinds. The first matches the text against a
dictionary. newmm , the default tokeniser of PyThaiNLP, uses maximum matching, and nlpO3 is an
adaptation of it in Rust ( Suntorntip et al., 2026 ) . TLTK joins syllables into words with a dictionary and their
collocation ( Aroonmanakun, 2026 ) . The second learns from a segmented corpus. DeepCut is a convolutional network over
characters ( Kittinaradorn et al., 2019 ) . AttaCut is a faster one, and its SC model also reads
syllables ( Chormai et al., 2019 ; Chormai et al., 2020 ) . SEFR CUT and OSKut add a second model, which re-scores the
output of DeepCut and so adapts it to a new domain ( Limkonchotiwat et al., 2020 ; Limkonchotiwat et al., 2021 ) .
khammoon is a small network for a CPU that segments morphemes, and our student follows its layout. Each model of
these tools follows one convention, that of the corpus or the dictionary it was built from.

blocks.en:
Corpora disagree on what a word is, and two lines of work accept
this. Multi-criteria models learn the conventions of several corpora in one network that is told which
convention to write ( Qiu et al., 2020 ; Huang et al., 2020 ) . Multi-grained segmentation gives one sentence several granularities
at once, with small words inside larger ones. Gong et al. (2017) built such data from three corpora
of different conventions. Japanese resources offer several granularities too. BCCWJ
is annotated in short and long unit words, and the tokeniser Sudachi splits in three modes ( Maekawa et al., 2014 ; Omura et al., 2021 ; Takaoka et al., 2018 ) . LATTE-WordSeg-Lite follows both lines for Thai, as each corpus
convention becomes one of its granularities.

一次,用小词 在更大的。 Gong等人(2017年)从三个公司建立了这种数据

公约成为其颗粒体之一。

blocks.en:
A character model reads a sentence character by character and does not see its words. A
lattice model adds them, as every dictionary word that matches the sentence becomes a node over the characters
that it spans ( Zhang and Yang, 2018 ; Li et al., 2020 ) . For Thai, an earlier model lets each character attend to its candidate
words and character clusters ( Chay-intr et al., 2021 ) . LATTE followed it, and encodes the lattice of a
sentence with a graph attention network.

一个角色模型逐个字读一个句子角色,而不见其词. 页:1
lattice模型添加了它们,因为每个字典中匹配句子的单词都会成为字符的节点
(张和杨,2018年;李等人,2020年). 对泰国来说,一个早期的模型让每个角色都照顾到其候选人
单词和字符组(Chay-intr等人,2021年). LATTE跟着它,并编码一个的纹章
带有图表关注网络的句子。

blocks.en:
The words of a lattice can also reach a model as features of each character, which is
faster ( Ma et al., 2020 ) . Before these models, a pointwise Japanese segmenter already marked, by length, whether
a dictionary word lies left of, right of or over a boundary ( Neubig et al., 2011 ) . So do our features.

纹饰的词也可以作为每个字符的特征达到一个模型,即:
更快(Ma等人,2020年). 在这些模型之前,一个指针的日语片段已经按长度标出是否
边界左侧、右侧或上空的字典词(Neubig等人,2011年)。 我们的特色也一样。

blocks.en:
A large model can teach a small one. In distillation, a small student learns from
the outputs of a large teacher, and not from gold labels alone ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) . This has made a
Chinese segmenter faster ( Huang et al., 2020 ) and a Japanese analyser smaller ( Tolmachev et al., 2019 ) ,
and LATTE-WordSeg-Lite does both for Thai.

(Hinton等人,2015年)。 这已经成为一个
中国分机更快(黄等人,2020年),日本分析器更小(托尔马乔夫等人,2019年),

blocks.en:
A score depends on more than the model. Rankings on a standard split may not hold on
other splits ( Gorman and Bedrick, 2019 ) . Random splits can overestimate performance ( Søgaard et al., 2021 ) .
Test items that repeat training items reward memorisation, not
generalisation ( Lewis et al., 2021 ; Elangovan et al., 2021 ) . For Thai, Chormai et al. (2019) compared
the tokenisers of their time on three domains with one scorer. Fu et al. (2020) revisited Chinese
segmentation in this spirit, and we revisit Thai word segmentation.

blocks.en: 3.1 Annotated Corpora, One Unit Each
blocks.zh: 3.1 附加说明的Corpora,每个股一个

blocks.en: In step 1, each Thai corpus is annotated in one unit. VISTEC keeps compounds whole, our long unit. TUD and Wisesight-1000 split them into words, short . khammoon splits words into morphemes, minimal . Each unit is thus the convention of its corpora, and its name is approximate.
blocks.zh: 在步骤1中,每件泰国文书都用一个单位附加说明。 VISTEC保存整个复合物 我们的长股 TUD和Wisesight-1000将它们分成单词,短.khampon将单词分成morphemes,最小. 因此,每个单位都是其公司的惯例,名称大致相同。

blocks.en:
These corpora are also different texts, of 9.57M, 0.30M and 7.17M characters. So no line carries all three
units, and short has far less data.

单位,而且数据少得多。

blocks.en: 3.2 Teachers
blocks.zh: 3.2 教师

blocks.en:
Step 2 trains teachers, which remove these two limits. A teacher that has learnt a
corpus can write its unit on any text. So every line can carry all three units, and each unit gets as much text as the
others. Without teachers, a network trained on the
corpora of one unit is 0.4 to 2.1 points lower over the seven test sets
(§ 5 ).

blocks.en:
Our teachers are LATTE models, and LATTE sees a text as a graph
(Figure 4 ). Each character is a node, and so is each dictionary word that matches the text. A link
joins two nodes when one ends where the other begins. A path of links from the start of the text to its end is
thus one reading. Graph attention passes information along the links in both directions. Each character then
gathers the words that cover it, and a CRF segments the text.

我们的老师是LATTE模型,LATTE将文本看作一个图表
(图4). 每个字符都是节点,每个字典中匹配文本的字词也一样. 链接
当一个节点结束于另一个节点时加入两个节点。 从案文开始到结尾的链接路径是

收集覆盖的文字,并用通用报告格式对文字进行分区。

blocks.en:
We rewrote LATTE for three reasons (Appendix B ). The first is speed . Our code takes a lattice word from the encoder states of its characters and batches the lattice
attention, so a training step is 3.6 times as fast at the same precision. The second is conventions . A corpus embedding and one CRF per corpus let one model learn each corpus in its own
convention, which gives LATTE-WordSeg-Lite its units. The third is soundness . The dictionary holds the training
vocabulary. So a word known only from training data is hidden from the lattice of its own sentence, as at test
time.
blocks.zh:

注意,所以一个训练步骤 以同样的精度是3.6倍。 第二是公约。 嵌入体和一个通用报告格式,让一个模型学习每个体本身

词汇。 所以一个只从训练数据中得知的词 隐藏在它自己的句子上 就像测试时一样

blocks.en: 3.4 Student
blocks.zh: 3.4 学生

blocks.en:
In step 4, the student learns from these probabilities alone, and
no label of the corpora themselves is among its targets. It follows the layout of khammoon, with character embeddings, convolutions of width 3, 5 and
7, and a two-layer BiLSTM, 1.17M parameters in all. It reads the lattice of LATTE as 13 yes-or-no features per
character (the bars of Figure 1 ). Six say whether a dictionary word starts at the character, one per
band of word length, and six whether one ends there. The last says whether the character lies strictly inside a
dictionary word (Appendix B ). The 13 bits thus keep the ends and the lengths of lattice words.
blocks.zh:
在第四步中,学生独自从这些概率中学习,
没有公司本身的标签 是它的目标。 它遵循khammoon的布局,带有字符嵌入,宽度3,5和
7,以及一个双层BILSTM,共1.17M参数. 它把LATTE的纹章读作13个是或否
字符(图1的栏)。 六说字典词是否从字符开始,一个字母
字长的波段,还有6个,如果一个结束在那里。 最后一个说字符是否严格地存在于一个
字典词(附录B). 13位因此保留了句尾和句子的长度.

blocks.en:
The student has one output per unit and learns the probabilities of the three units at
once, by binary cross-entropy. It trains for 60K steps of up to 32,768 characters, 26 passes over the text. It ships

blocks.en: 4.1 Test Sets
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 测试集

blocks.en:
The first condition is the test file. We use seven test sets (Table 2 ). TUD and PUD are two Thai treebanks of
Universal Dependencies ( de Marneffe et al., 2021 ; Sriwirote et al., 2025 ; Zeman et al., 2017 ) . WS160 ( Suriyawongkul et al., 2024 ) and VISTEC, short for VISTEC-TP-TH-2021 ( Limkonchotiwat et al., 2021 ) , are
social media. khm is the human test set of khammoon, 2,000 instruction documents ( Limkonchotiwat et al., 2025 ) . The official test set of BEST has no gold boundaries in its public release,
and ORCHID ( Sornlertlamvanich et al., 1999 ) has no test split. We therefore split both 80/10/10 ourselves.

第一个条件是测试文件. 我们使用七套测试(表2)。 TUD和PUD是泰国的两个树岸:
普遍属地(de Marneffe等人,2021年;Sriwirote等人,2025年;Zeman等人,2017年). WS160 (Suriyawongkul等人,2024年)和VISTEC,简称为VISTEC-TP-TH-2021(Limkonchotiwat等人,2021年),分别是:

和ORCHID(Sornlertlamvanich等人,1999年)没有试验分裂。 因此,我们自己把80/10/10分开。

blocks.en:
We then clean the sets in three ways. ORCHID stores punctuation as tags, so we rebuild its
sentences as natural text. In every set, we let a space always separate words. Last, lines repeat between the
training and test text of a corpus.
The web address of a newspaper fills 136 test lines of BEST, and the heading “Abstract” 15 of ORCHID. We remove
such repeats from these two sets, whose splits are ours. For khm,
we report both scores, with and without its repeats of the training text of khammoon (the set khmdd).

培训和测试一项文书。

blocks.en: 4.3 Scoring

blocks.en:
The third condition is the scorer, which must know what a word is. The corpora
cut the same word differently. kanthamngan , “working”, is usually one word in VISTEC, two in ORCHID
( kan | | thamngan ) and three in BEST and khm ( kan | | tham | | ngan ). Each set is
therefore scored in its own convention. A system with several units uses the unit trained on that convention,
or else the unit chosen on held-out data of the same corpus (Appendix E ).
Table 2 names it for each set.

blocks.en:
Each set is then scored with the two metrics of the LATTE paper (Figure 6 ). Word F1 is its word-level F1. A word of the system, cut at every space, is correct when a gold word has the same start
and the same end.
blocks.zh:
每套都随LATTE纸的两个度量衡(图6)而得分. 单词F1是其单词级的F1. 系统的一个字,在每一个空间切, 当一个金字有相同的开始时是正确的
和同样的结局。

blocks.en:
Boundary F1 is the character-level F1 of that paper. A cut between two characters is correct when gold
cuts there too. A space separates words, so the cuts next to a space, and the start of a line, are given
to every system. We leave them out, as the metric of khammoon does.
blocks.zh:
边界F1是该文件的字符级F1. 黄金时在两个字符之间切除是正确的
切那边也。 空格分隔单词, 从而给出一个空格旁边的剪切, 以及一行的开始
每一个系统。 我们把他们排除在外,就像卡姆月的衡量标准一样。

blocks.en:
In Figure 6 , one missing cut costs one boundary but three words, so boundary F1 is usually the

lines.

线条。

Last, we check our runs of the other tools. Each runs with its released model. To

four of the five tools of the khammoon table match their papers to the decimal printed.
AttaCut and newmm match less well.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
The idea of LATTE is to read a text at several granularities at once, and it survives on a CPU. LATTE-WordSeg-Lite reads the
lattice as 13 bits per character, which add 1.3 points on VISTEC and 0.2 on
average. The larger gain comes from the teachers, whose labels on raw text carry each unit beyond its corpus. On
average, the student is as accurate as these labels, with 1.17M parameters against 635M for each teacher, on
one CPU thread.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
The seven sets cover encyclopedic, news, fiction, social-media, technical and instruction
text. Other domains, such as transcribed speech, are not covered. Our BEST and ORCHID splits are random at the line
level and are not official test sets. A model trained on the rest of such a corpus may score higher on them than on
new text.

语句。 其他域,如转写语音,则不涵盖. 我们最好的和ORCHID的分裂是随机的
级别而非正式测试集。 训练有素的模特儿 可能会比他们高
新文本。

blocks.en:
Our rule that a space separates words changes some source tokens, so scores differ from those
on the original tokenisation. Upstream defects are kept as published (Appendix C ). Our intervals cover test sampling only.
They are not corrected for multiple comparisons, and they treat the lines of one document as independent.

Table 5 lists the twelve systems of Table 1 , which are nine tools, three of them with two models.
Each ran on the same lines and on one CPU thread, in one of five Python environments. It used its released model and default
settings, apart from the engines that Table 5 names.

blocks.en:
The last column names the test sets whose lines are in the training corpus of the system. Their scores are in
parentheses in Table 1 . For LATTE-WordSeg-Lite, it names none, as it learnt from Wisesight-1000 without the
WS160 lines, and from CC BY-SA rows of khammoon that hold no khm test document. The row of khammoon names BEST,
as its training text holds 147,999 sentences of the BEST training set, labelled as morphemes by a language model. Every line of our BEST test set is among them. DeepCut and AttaCut were each trained on 90% of BEST, so they have seen most of our test lines.
blocks.zh:
最后一栏为系统培训大纲中包含的测试集命名。 他们的分数在
表1中的括号。对于LATTE-WordSeg-Lite,它没有命名,因为它从Wisesight-1000中得知,没有

blocks.en:
SEFR CUT and OSKut refine the output of DeepCut with a second model trained on one corpus. The scads engine of OSKut was trained on the split of VISTEC used in the OSKut paper, which contains 72% of the
test lines of the corpus repository. Their TNHC engines and the LST20 engine of OSKut, which have no test set
here, were not run. Nor were their transfer-learned variants and the augmented one of OSKut. TLTK also ships a
list of BEST words for shorter units, which we did not run. As for licences, the code of DeepCut, AttaCut, SEFR CUT and OSKut is MIT-licensed. Their models were trained on
BEST (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), directly or through DeepCut. The code of khammoon is Apache-2.0, and its weights are
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as stated on its model card.

BEST(CC BY-NC-SA 3.0),直接或通过DeepCut. Khammoon的代码是Apache-2.0,其重量是
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 如其模式卡所示.

Table 6 gives the exact speeds behind Table 3 and Figure 2 ,
with peak memory. Every tool segments the same 768 lines on one thread of an Intel Xeon Platinum 8468, with model
loading left out. The lines are the validation part of the development set of khammoon (150,894 characters),
used here for timing only. A run takes the best of up to three rounds, and the best run of a tool counts. Over its
two runs, LATTE-WordSeg-Lite ran at 97–105K characters per second, and khammoon at 40–43K over its four. Every thread pool was set to one thread, but the TensorFlow tools still used
1.27–1.36 cores (CPU time over wall time). DeepCut, SEFR CUT and OSKut ran on TensorFlow 2.15, AttaCut on
PyTorch 2.5, and khammoon and LATTE-WordSeg-Lite on ONNX Runtime 1.32 and 1.31.

与峰值记忆。 每个工具都在同一条线上的768条线段, 一条英特尔Xeon Platinum 8468, 有型号
装货时未加载。 线路是khammoon开发集的验证部分(150,894个字符),,
这里只用于时间。 跑步最多需要三轮,工具的最佳跑步算数. 超过它

PyTorch 2.5, 和 Khammoon 和 LATTE-WordSeg-Lite on ONNX Runtime 1.32和1.31.

blocks.en:
khammoon and SEFR CUT take all lines in one call, and the other tools one line per call. DeepCut makes one
prediction call per line, which bounds its speed. The row per line of LATTE-WordSeg-Lite is the lower of two runs of earlier
models of its architecture, each right after its batched rounds. In a later session, the released model ran at
110K characters per second batched and at 62K per line, in rounds that alternate.
DeepCut ran at 2.8K in that session, 22.5 times slower, and khammoon at
39K per line. LATTE-WordSeg-Lite runs as an int8 graph and khammoon in float32. In another session, our
network ran at 61K characters per second in float32, its int8 graph at 111K and khammoon at
46K.

khammoon 和 SEFR CUT 将所有线路都用一个调用,其他工具每调用一条调用. 深处 切一个
每个线的预测调用,它限制了它的速度。 LATTE-WordSeg-Lite的每行是早先两行的下行
其架构的模型, 每一个在它的批次回合之后。 在后期,发布模型运行于
每秒分批110K字符,每行62K字符,以交替的回合计.
DepCut在那场比赛中跑到2.8K,慢了22.5倍,Khammoon在比赛中
每条线路39K. LATTE-WORDSeg-Lite作为Int8图和浮点32中的卡姆月运行. 在另一届会议上,我们
网络在浮点32中以每秒61K字符运行,其整数图在111K和卡姆月
46K (英语).

blocks.en:
The second engines of SEFR CUT and OSKut were not timed. They re-score every position, where the engines timed
re-score 5% and 33% of them, so they would be slower. The teacher was timed for one convention. On the CPU thread, it
read the first 60 lines of this text. On the GPU, it read the text 20 times over, as when it labelled the raw text.
Its layers were compiled, and six CPU processes prepared its input. Its short labels mix two conventions, so they take two passes and
twice the time.
blocks.zh:
SEFR CUT和OSKut的第二引擎没有定时. 引擎的定时位置
重新获得5%和33%的分数,因此速度会放慢。 老师是来参加一个大会的 在CPU线条上
阅读此文本的前60行。 在GPU上,它阅读了20倍的文本,就像它给原始文本贴上标签一样.
它的分层被编译,六个CPU过程准备了它的投入. 它的短标签混合了两个公约,所以它们需要两个通行证和
两倍的时间。

blocks.en:
PyThaiNLP wraps most of these tools. nlpO3 is an adaptation of its newmm in Rust, run here with the
same dictionary. Their outputs differ by up to 1.9 points on a set. PyThaiNLP also has
four more word tokenisers of its own (Table 7 ), all run with its default dictionary. newmm-safe guards newmm against inputs that take it very long. longest and mm use longest
and maximum matching. nercut merges the output of a named-entity tagger. None comes closer to the neural
systems than newmm . Its ICU tokeniser was not run, as PyICU, which it needs, was not available
in the Python 3.11 environment of these tools.

PyThaiNLP将大部分这些工具包起来. 无 O3是它在Rust的新枪的改编 和它一起运行在这里
同一个词典。 其产出在一组产出上的差异高达1.9点。 PyThaiNLP还拥有
另有四个单词表示器(表7),全部以其默认词典运行. 新毫米安全警卫新毫米 与需要很长时间的投入。 使用时间最长和毫米
和最大比对。 nercut合并了命名实体标记器的输出. 没有比神经病更近的了
系统比新毫米。 它的ICU标志器没有运行,因为它需要的PyICU没有可用
这些工具的Python 3.11环境。

blocks.en: Appendix B Model and Training
blocks.zh: 附录B 模式和培训

blocks.en:
A lattice word is embedded from the encoder states of its first and
last characters and their mean, with a hashed identity. The released LATTE code runs the encoder once per word
instead. The bidirectional lattice attention works on batched neighbour lists, not on one graph per sentence. On CTB6
with bert-base-chinese, a training step on 16 sentences takes 0.071 s in fp32 (0.062 s in bf16), against 0.257 s
for the released code in fp32 on the same GPU. A word that only the training data contains is hidden from the
lattice of the sentences it comes from.
blocks.zh:
从编码器中嵌入了第一个和
最后的人物和他们的恶毒, 有散列身份。 已发布的 LATTE 代码每字运行一次编码器
相反。 双向的线条注意在批量的邻居名单中工作,而不是每句一个图. 在 CDB6 上
使用 bert-base-chinese,16个句子的训练步骤在fp32中为0.071 s(bf16中为0.062 s),而0.257 s
对于在同一GPU上的fp32中发布的代码。 只包含培训数据的一个词隐藏在
句子的纹饰

blocks.en:
We also measured what the lattice and its graph layers add. On our BEST split before de-duplication, our LATTE with multilingual BERT scores 97.69 word F1. The same encoder
with a CRF and no lattice scores 96.81. Trained on longer chunks, our LATTE scores 97.65 with its two graph
layers and 97.45 without them. Each number is one run. These models are for research only, as BEST is licensed for non-commercial use, and none of
them is a teacher of LATTE-WordSeg-Lite.
blocks.zh:
我们还测量了花纹及其图层所增加的。 我们的LATTE以多语种BERT的成绩为97.69字F1。 同样的编码器
使用通用报告格式,无纹章分数96.81. 我们的LATTE的成绩是97.65.
层和97.45没有它们。 每个数字都是一跑 这些模型仅用于研究,因为最佳范例被许可用于非商业用途,而且没有任何一种模式用于研究。
他们是LATTE-WordSeg-Lite的老师.

blocks.en:
The released dictionary has 177,385 words. It is the union of the word
lists and the training vocabulary of Teacher 1 (190,037 words), minus 12,652 entries that look like personal
data. Removing them changes no test score by more than 0.11. The six bands of word length of the lattice bits are
2, 3, 4, 5–6, 7–9 and 10–16 characters. The 13 bits of a character select one of 8,192 embeddings. In decoding, a word may not start at a combining mark or a following vowel, nor right after a
leading vowel. Runs of ASCII letters or of digits are never split. Every long boundary is a short boundary, as the short logit is the maximum of both. minimal is decoded on its own, because khammoon keeps
together some punctuation that short splits. On the khammoon development documents, minimal reaches a boundary
F1 of 99.80 on its own, against 99.24 when they are nested in those of short .

列表和教师1的培训词汇表(190 037字),减去12 652个看起来像个人的条目
数据。 移除后,测试分数不会超过0.11。 线条长度的六段是
2,3,4,5–6,7–9和10–16个字符. 一个字符的13位选择了8,192个嵌入符中的一个. 在解码中,一个单词可能不会从组合标记或后面的元音开始,也不会从后面的元音开始。
领先元音. ASCII 字母的运行或数字的运行永远不会被分割. 每个长的边界都是短的边界,因为短的对数是两者的最大. 最小值是自行解码的,因为 Khammoon 保存
加上一些小分数 Khammoon 开发文件上, 最小到一个边界
单靠99.80的F1, 而单靠99.24, 它们被窝在短的。

blocks.en: Appendix D Published Scores, Reproduced
blocks.zh: 附录D 分数, 重制

blocks.en:
Thai segmentation papers score in three ways, which give different numbers for the same output. SEFR CUT and
OSKut count over the whole test file and keep the spaces. Every character is a word start or not, and every token,
a space included, is a word. AttaCut and the PyThaiNLP benchmark remove the spaces and average over lines.
khammoon scores the cuts between two non-space characters, as we do.
blocks.zh:
泰国分片纸以三种方式得分,为同一产出给出了不同的数字. 联邦渔业局
OSKut计算整个测试文件并保留空格. 每一个角色都是一个词开始与否, 每个符号,
a 包括空格,是一个单词。 AttaCut和PyThaiNLP基准取消了空格和线上的平均值.
Khammoon在两个非空间字符之间得分,就像我们一样。

blocks.en:
Table 13 applies each way to our stored outputs, on the test file of each paper. For VISTEC,
this is the split that the OSKut paper used, which the README of its repository links. For Wisesight, it is
Wisesight-1000 and WS160 as published. OSKut and DeepCut are reproduced to the second decimal of the OSKut paper,
but for the word-level score of OSKut on WS160, which is 0.01 lower. SEFR CUT is reproduced in the row of its own
paper. Four of the five tools of the khammoon table match it to the decimal it
prints, and the fifth, AttaCut-SC, is 0.4 below it. Only TLTK, and the best engine of SEFR CUT, have no
published score to check against.
AttaCut matches the benchmark of its authors at the two digits printed there, and differs from the other papers by
up to 1.8. The SEFR CUT paper trained its own AttaCut-SC model. newmm differs by 2.1 on the PyThaiNLP
benchmark. These numbers date from 2019 to 2021, and we do not know their releases. Published numbers
disagree too, as the SEFR CUT paper lists DeepCut 0.3 higher at character level than the OSKut paper and our run.
blocks.zh:
表13以各种方式适用于每份文件的测试文件中储存的产出。 对于VISTEC,
这是 OSKut 文件使用的分割, 其寄存器的 README 链接到它 。 对于智慧,它是
Wissight-1000和WS160发布. OSKut和DeepCut被复制到OSKut纸张的第二小数,
但对于WS160上的OSKut的单词级分数,则低0.01. SEFR CUT在自己的行中复制
纸 Khammoon表格的五个工具中有四个 与十进制相匹配
指纹,第五个是AttaCut-SC,下面是0.4。 只有TLTK和SEFR CUT最好的引擎没有
已公布的分数来核对。
AttaCut 符合作者在打印时的两位数的基准,
最高1.8岁。 SEFR CUT论文培训了自己的AttaCut-SC模型. 新毫米在 PyThaiNLP 上与 2.1 不同
基准。 这些数字从2019年到2021年,我们不知道他们的释放. 已公布编号
同样不同意,因为SEFR CUT的论文列出了在字符级别上比OSKut的论文和我们的运行要高0.3的DeepCut.

blocks.en:
One published score is on lines that no tool has seen. On the official test set of BEST, the AttaCut paper reports
a word F1 of 0.93 for DeepCut, as a mean over lines ( Chormai et al., 2019 ) . Scored that way, our
BEST test lines give 0.96. newmm , which learns nothing from BEST, moves as much, from
0.67 to 0.70. So the lines that DeepCut has seen explain little of the gap between its BEST
score and its other scores, which is mostly a matter of convention.
blocks.zh:
一个公布的分数是在没有工具看到的线上. AttaCut的论文报告
用于DeepCut的F1单词为0.93,作为跨行平均值(Chormai等人,2019年). 那样打分,我们
最佳试验线为0.96 newmm,它没有从Best学到什么, 移动一样多,从
0.67改为0.70. 因此,DeepCut所看到的线条 几乎没有解释它最优的差别
得分和其他的得分,这主要是惯例问题。

LATTE-WordSeg-Lite can also list the k k most probable segmentations of a line. They are the k k best paths through a lattice of the dictionary words in the line and the words of its three units. The start
probabilities of the student score each path. For taklom (Figure 4 ), it lists ta|klom (‘round eyes’) first and tak|lom (‘out in the wind’) third. The lists are made one line at a time, where the
average word F1 is 85.64, with short on every set. Taking for each line the best of its top 3 raises it to
88.74. The top 5 and 10 give 89.92
and 91.26. These are upper bounds, since the gold standard picks the reading. On TUD, the first reading is
right for the whole line in 39% of the lines, and one of the top 3 in 60%.
